narrative.intro: National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia recorded federal contract obligations totaling $4.7B in FY2026 to date. The company has 1 award this period, with an average award size of $4.7B. Obligations are down 16.5% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations show a multi-year pattern: FY21 was $4.3B, FY22 was $4.3B, FY23 was $4.7B, FY24 was $5B, FY25 was $5.7B, and FY26 is $4.7B. The current-year total is a fiscal year to date figure and represents contract obligations rather than award-value totals unless otherwise noted in award tables. Readers should treat the FY2026 number as a partial year total while comparing across fiscal years.
